newsitem.title: HONG KONG: LG Chemical signs US$66 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LG Chemical signs US$66 mln loan.

text.p: LG Chemical Ltd's US$66 million five-year term loan facility was signed on Thursday in Seoul, said arranger DKB Asia.
The syndicated amount was oversubscribed but not increased, arranger said.
The loan pays a margin of 45 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 51 basis points.
Proceeds of the loan will be used to provide funding for the borrower's overseas investment.
Arrangers and lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Credit Lyonnais, DKB Asia, IBJ Asia and Korea Development Bank.
Co-arrangers and lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Mitsubishi Trust, Sumitomo Trust and Bayerische Landesbank.
Lead managers, with US$3.5 million each, are Bank of Yokohama, Chiba Bank, Credit Industriel et Commercial, Mitsui Trust, Norinchukin Bank, Toyo Trust and Yamaguchi Bank.
Managers are Aomori Bank and Banca di Roma, with US$2.5 million each, and Toho Bank, with US$1.5 million.
